meta_description: NCL Building Co in Newcastle delivers reliable construction services for residential and commercial projects. Expert builders serving North East England. Call today.
hero_eyebrow: Established Local Builders — North East Construction Specialists
hero_subhead: From extensions to commercial builds, we deliver on time and on budget. Free site survey and honest quotes.
services_subhead: Whether you need a loft conversion, kitchen extension, or full commercial build, we handle it all with precision and care.

services.title: House Extensions
services.desc: Single and double storey extensions that blend seamlessly with your home. We manage planning permission, building control, and structural work so you don't have to.

services.title: Loft Conversions
services.desc: Transform your attic into valuable living space. Fully insulated, with proper ventilation and structural support. Typical project takes 8–10 weeks.

services.title: Kitchen & Bathroom Refits
services.desc: Complete redesign and installation, from plumbing through to tiling and joinery. We source quality units and keep disruption to a minimum.

services.title: Commercial Builds
services.desc: Retail fit-outs, office refurbishment, and new-build projects. We maintain strict health and safety standards and work to your schedule.

services.title: Brickwork & Pointing
services.desc: Lime mortar repointing and brickwork repairs that restore period properties and extend masonry life. Using traditional methods where appropriate.

services.title: Roofing & Guttering
services.desc: Slate, tile, or asphalt roofing, plus guttering replacement and repair. We inspect for damage and provide weatherproofing guarantees.

about_pullquote: We build homes and businesses the way we'd want ours done.
about_para_1: NCL Building Co was founded in 2009 by local Newcastle tradesman Craig Lewis, who got frustrated watching clients overcharged and let down by distant contractors. Over 15 years, we've grown from a two-man operation to a team of 12 skilled builders, bricklayers, and site managers—all based in the North East. We've completed over 400 projects, from Victorian terrace refurbishments to modern commercial developments.
about_para_2: Our reputation is built on showing up on time, keeping costs realistic, and finishing the job right. We don't cut corners, and we don't disappear when snags arise. Around 60% of our work comes from repeat customers and referrals, which tells you everything about how we operate. We're proud to be Constructionline accredited and work regularly with local councils and housing associations.
reviews_heading: What Newcastle & Gateshead Clients Say About Us

reviews.text: Craig and his team knocked down a wall between our kitchen and lounge. Messy job, but they kept the chaos contained, left the site clean every evening, and finished a week early. Couldn't fault it. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: Richard T.

reviews.text: Had a loft conversion quote from three firms. NCL's price was fair and realistic—no hidden costs. The team was professional, respectful of the house, and communicated every step. Our new bedroom is brilliant.
reviews.author: Emma D.

reviews.text: We use NCL for all our commercial maintenance work. They understand timescales, they're reliable, and they don't faff about with paperwork. Proper tradesmen. Would definitely use again.
reviews.author: Mark S.
